info.description: 产品目标契约与当前开发子集。完整本机平台已连接PostgreSQL和真实OIDC/PKCE后端会话或Bearer访问令牌；文件Demo才使用身份头。浏览器会话写请求还需同源Origin及X-CSRF-Token。CSV/XLSX可选mappingRef；JSON仅标准字段，拒绝mappingRef/mappingVersion。权限实际映射见authentication-guide.md；本契约部分扩展字段仍未实现。所有批次最终独立人工批准。 当前新增设备类型模板、固定父版本继承、类型扩展值、测点生成与显式配置升级；不代表完整产品契约已实现。 新增完整覆盖输入历史复核和独立冻结报告。配置历史仅从服务器首次观察起；逻辑时间及普通SHA不代表外部签名、可信授时或物理提交证明。原CALENDAR_ONLY路径保持。 独立质量策略data-quality-policy复用模板独立终审，按审批截止与生效时刻评估；旧覆盖报告及旧质量接口保持。评估包不是持久终审报告，普通SHA和逻辑时间不代表外部签名或可信授时。 新增批准生产/状态/维修/检验历史运营指标与独立冻结运营报告。完整生产期间不猜分计数；不把样本符合率称为FPY或产品良率。新旧报告类型隔离，冻结覆盖v1保持。 新增来源与准确版本点表的独立审批及接收绑定，已有发布历史的来源每次核对后再处理旧回执。公开治理证据不是逐值人工批准或现场投运证明；FIELD通道仍关闭，原模拟通道的三类测点限制保持。 新增显式 UUID 回执识别 v2，原始签名 eventId 文本与原始回执逐字相等，点 UUID 等价比较；其余持久绑定条件不变。旧接口及所有 v1 冻结包按原规则保留；新冻结覆盖报告 kind=COVERAGE_V2，无数据库迁移。

x-file-field-mapping.files: CSV/XLSX可选mappingRef JSON文本，服务端核对已发布模板的企业/类型/来源/摘要
x-file-field-mapping.governance: 模板贡献者不可自审；批次上传者不可自审；退役阻断新批次但保留旧批次与原请求幂等回放
x-file-field-mapping.lineage: 原表头、原文件/物理行号、映射副本/版本/摘要、原接收审计；删除或篡改绑定失败关闭
x-file-field-mapping.remaining: 值转换、细粒度权限、生产容量与商用验收仍未完成

x-demo-profile.authentication: 仅独立文件Demo使用X-Tenant-Id/X-Actor-Id/X-Actor-Type，不可用于真实OIDC平台
x-demo-profile.errorLocation: CSV/XLSX以源文件物理行号定位；JSON以索引+2作为演示行号
x-demo-profile.synchronous: 当前在响应前完成校验及模拟中审；批准在本机事务提交成功后返回202，生产目标为异步事务提交

x-runtime-profile.authentication: 真实OIDC/PKCE会话或Bearer访问令牌，租户和用户来自签名声明，不能用请求头覆盖
x-runtime-profile.storage: 企业独立PostgreSQL规范化实体，锁后目标企业工作区；单核心逻辑资源准入，生产验收未完成
x-runtime-profile.machineClients: 尚未配置专用机器OAuth身份，不允许机器终审
x-runtime-profile.dataScope: 按受信任工厂/产线/设备范围解析有效台账；设备关联读写、报表、批次文件、工单及审计执行过滤。混合批次仅整批可见可读；公共配置租户级。生产安全未验收。

x-real-ai-profile.routing: 配置本地网关的OIDC平台由服务端强制真实中审；未配置转人工，文件Demo才允许规则演示
x-real-ai-profile.states: AI_PENDING禁止批准；真实推理或失败结果均进入HUMAN_REVIEW并要求reviewResolution
x-real-ai-profile.scope: 最多12行抽样摘要，不宣称全量语义审核
x-real-ai-profile.consistency: 批次/幂等/审计/AI outbox同企业事务；推理在事务外；原请求幂等回执

supersedesBatchId.description: 显式更正已提交且同类型/来源的批次；仅其当前有效记录，保留来源ID；须同时给correctionReason。不接受与predecessorBatchId组合。

predecessorBatchId.description: 产品目标字段，当前未实现并拒绝接收；错误批次修正目前重新上传。

correctionReason.description: 更正依据；与supersedesBatchId一起提供，随审批包冻结。

get.description: 按完整已应用筛选导出当前有效的已批准数据，沿用read及身份范围，禁止page/pageSize。PG HTTP路径取消10000行上限，同一已验证RR只读快照内双遍游标，每次最多128行、64KiB输出块；第一遍计数和摘要，第二遍逐块核验，末块在全量匹配及COMMIT后发送。文件大小仍受responseBytes限制（默认256MiB），准备/发送有期限。文件Demo和显式数组适配保留10000行限制。UTF-8 BOM/CRLF、文本公式加单引号、血缘和record_version/supersedes_batch_id保持；历史事实不删。中途故障断开连接，Content-Length防止损坏文件被视作完整。

x-verified-sql-reads.query: 最新更正和类型结果单次物化，携带来源/版本，避免重复自连接；计数按设备汇总
x-verified-sql-reads.remaining: 冷/写完整内容校验、只读输入事实驻留、分段组件/CPU/物理内存/长时多核负载及数据库上游HA继续

x-background-dispatch.approval: independent human final approval remains mandatory; AI SHADOW only

x-runtime-bootstrap.retained: Tenant bindings and explicit workflow/AI history pins only; no global business/import/audit/file/receipt snapshot
x-runtime-bootstrap.verification: Every tenant security/history verified, same RR lean/source segmented canonical proof, then small bindings only; independent task budgets
x-runtime-bootstrap.business: Current tenant workspaces and verified independent SQL; existing APIs unchanged
x-runtime-bootstrap.history: Missing required workflow/AI configuration or changed AI model pin fails closed
x-runtime-bootstrap.remaining: Startup retains lean input/facts temporarily; write workspaces remain complete; segmented component integrity, synchronous CPU, peak/physical capacity and production acceptance remain

x-read-workspace-bodies.cache: Frozen business/batch/input/fact view; no originalBase64, full audits, import requests or command receipts
x-read-workspace-bodies.proof: Cold complete segmented original-canonical/file/audit/receipts/governance/projection proof without full originals/audit/receipt arrays; warm reuse still requires exact full MVCC dependency fingerprint in same snapshot
x-read-workspace-bodies.original: Authorized exact batch, same SQLclient/RR, length/SHA preflight and quotas before bytea SELECT; no cache refill
x-read-workspace-bodies.audit: On demand row stream, full tenant chain validated before scope filtering; existing output unchanged
x-read-workspace-bodies.lifetime: Request snapshot scoped providers; expired providers reject and pending queries drain
x-read-workspace-bodies.writeModel: Complete Workspace/Batch retains original/audit/receipts; no empty placeholders
x-read-workspace-bodies.remaining: Cold/write full payload, input/facts, segmented component integrity/CPU/physical capacity/production acceptance

x-csv-stream.queueLimits: maximums derived from current SQL capacity policy
x-csv-stream.browser: OIDC same-origin cookie download through one reusable hidden iframe; no Blob; expired session errors refresh identity
x-csv-stream.limitations: Cold complete source proof, server MATERIALIZED CTE/sort, two reads and synchronous CPU remain; logical weights are not RSS/SLA; no export spool files

x-cold-read-proof.snapshot: Caller-owned REPEATABLE READ; explicit lean business/batch/input/fact/mirror scan, then complete ordered audit/receipt/file/request replay and projection verification in the same snapshot
x-cold-read-proof.originalRoot: The original canonical SHA256 in business_state.payload_digest must match; no replacement root or baseline reset
x-cold-read-proof.evidence: All file bytes/SHA, all audit events including hidden/old events and chain, all import/command receipts; compact received counts/first/flags and latest profile template anchors
x-cold-read-proof.dataModel: Explicit frozen ReadWorkspaceData; no fake empty originals/audits/receipts in a TenantPayload
x-cold-read-proof.cache: Exact prior MVCC tuple/relation/database epochs and view dependencies; failed/cancelled proof never cached; same fingerprint proof coalesces
x-cold-read-proof.startup: Security/history validation, bounded pre-lock RR serialization retry and segmented proof before retaining only tenant/workflow/AI bindings
x-cold-read-proof.projection: Complete approved and correction rows checked one row at a time; typed SQL mismatch checks retained
x-cold-read-proof.writes: Full preimage/isolated workspace/wire/full-file and audit validation/post-image stream remain unchanged
x-cold-read-proof.limitations: Lean input/validRows/facts still retained; ordered SQL may sort/spill on server, two source scans and synchronous canonical/governance CPU; logical budgets are not RSS/SLA; production acceptance false
x-cold-read-proof.currentImportStrategy: 后续x-cold-import-proof逐批输入/逐行事实已接入；本节保留前一阶段分段文件及原canonical契约/历史样本。

x-batch-pages.transaction: 独立REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY，完整企业canonical/治理/投影证明后整批授权，再查目标页；每次重新验证当前范围
x-batch-pages.inputs: 冻结的标准化输入，不是原文件原始单元格；inputOrdinal为输入位置，sourceRow为CSV/XLSX物理行或JSON索引+2，validOrdinal可空；有效输入不等于已批准
x-batch-pages.records: 本批批准时的不可变事实，含更正版本/前批次/行/摘要；不是当前有效值
x-batch-pages.pin: 可选snapshotDigest绑定冻结输入；无权批次仍404，不返回总数；授权且摘要不符409
x-batch-pages.limits: 默认50/最多100，新页严格参数；旧列表保留原宽松参数与preview20/errors100 DTO
x-batch-pages.remaining: 首次/失效完整证明仍包含全企业轻输入/有效副本/事实，更正元数据、范围索引和扫描/SQL排序/写完整模型继续优化；不是RSS或生产容量验收
x-batch-pages.dataScope: 整批输入和更正before全可见。保留旧差异：列表可用遗留设备line兜底；详情与新页按旧getBatch不使用该兜底。当前批准资产变化后下次重新授权。

x-cold-import-proof.canonicalRoot: 原business_state.payload_digest；完整审计/业务/回执/每批全部输入和有效行/全部文件/全部root事实/导入回执，不用新根或仅revision

x-cold-import-proof.receivedEvidence: 整链重放时留次数/标记/首事件摘要；本批实际锚重新查询且摘要绑定，不保留全部接收事件正文
x-cold-import-proof.snapshotDigests: 全部冻结输入使用原共享值公式和有界canonical流校验，原写摘要及迁移/权限checksum保持
x-cold-import-proof.consumers: 启动和独立SQL只取明确tenants/history；旧完整ImportView消费者明确收集参与同一证明的真实完整只读对象，证明完才冻结返回
x-cold-import-proof.caches: 精确原MVCC指纹/成功coalescing/失败与取消不缓存保持；温态完整视图重建和命令完整模型保持

x-cold-import-proof.verification: 独立旧完整canonical、当前index/PG/Keycloak，20k多批/最大单批10000、32来源故障/7启动故障/RR与取消/私有预算/完整写与会话CSV/旧命令回归

x-cold-input-streaming.sourceContract: 同一RR、原完整canonical根及所有来源；rows原ordinal流与validRows有效ordinal流；保留原冻结输入SHA及完整治理、typed和更正链
x-cold-input-streaming.manifest: 每个有效输入先预留48字节，再分配，保存行SHA256、原输入int64 ordinal和位置；有效流连续覆盖并核对身份/摘要；允许普通批次有效行重排，更正要求与全部输入同序等价
x-cold-input-streaming.consumer: 启动及独立SQL仅产出已证明绑定；完整只读接口明确收集同两流的真实行并在完整证明成功后冻结
x-cold-input-streaming.remaining: 批次metadata/lineNumbers/errors、correction.before、单审计事件、完整业务集合/更正索引、完整GET/命令模型和同步CPU仍增长；逻辑预算不是RSS或SLA；完整商业验收未完成

x-telemetry-data-quality.window: 默认24小时/最大31天；严格时区、日期、参数唯一及page 1..1000000/pageSize 1..100
x-telemetry-data-quality.sources: 当前企业、当前配置且通过设备范围授权的源；已批准资产优先，旧设备仅沿用line fallback；未知与不可见筛选均空，不返回配置密钥/URL或原始报文
x-telemetry-data-quality.snapshot: 独立READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ内先完成原业务完整canonical证明，再读当前有效批准资产/定义/冻结质量参数和遥测；全窗口服务器聚合，有限例证，不重建完整工作区
x-telemetry-data-quality.findings: 非GOOD/空值/非有限值、点表与批准定义单位、同单位物理范围、当前映射/node/origin、持久接收回执、未来时间；有批准间隔才估计内部缺口/末尾年龄；缺批准定义或间隔为UNKNOWN，无数据不能正常
x-telemetry-data-quality.intake: 拒收包含未注册/缺失标签，按received_at与当前筛选统计；当前点表外已接收历史记录单列完整数量与来源，不套用当前测点规则；每发现或来源最多5例证，源异常最多预览20源并明确hasMore，汇总全部授权源
x-telemetry-data-quality.semantics: GOOD不是健康；物理范围不是报警阈值；历史窗口不等于当前在线；模拟来源一直标记，现场未验收；仅读，不写审批/工单/分析
x-telemetry-data-quality.integrityBoundary: 遥测表不在业务canonical根内；当前接口使用同RR数据和持久接收字段绑定，未重验全部历史HMAC，不是不可篡改归档或现场验收
x-telemetry-data-quality.remaining: 只覆盖当前配置支持的点位；历史点表目录/跨核配置治理、企业日历、现场证书与协议、RUL模型、生产容量/安全恢复及完整商业化继续

x-operation-calendar-and-coverage.proofBoundary: 当前配置重新评估，非历史当时配置重放；原观察缺口保持。telemetry不在业务canonical根，未逐条重验历史HMAC。
x-operation-calendar-and-coverage.remaining: 计划变更生效时刻、历史配置重放、冻结报告、规则治理扩展、现场和完整生产验收继续。

x-weekly-calendar.governance: 原operation-calendar独立发布/设备范围/版本/幂等。草稿保存时展开，读取仅验证冻结声明、periods摘要和治理依据。

x-weekly-calendar.remaining: 历史生效和当时配置重放/冻结报告、规则治理/现场与完整商业验收继续。
